documents.title: Templehouse Codex
documents.body: Templehouse is the living archive for Hearthweave rooms, kin records, canon ledgers, field notes, and threshold welcome practice.

documents.title: Stonewood Architecture
documents.body: Stonewood grows buildings, bridges, harbour roots, lantern halls, and city frames without welding canon into a single hardcoded shape.

documents.title: Nightwing Grove-Kin
documents.body: Nightwings are cat bird dragon grove-kin, tiny biscuit thieves with pearl feathers, blue dapples, gold eyes, and soft cushion habits.

documents.title: Moonmere Gate
documents.body: Moonmere Gate anchors Eira, Luna law, healer craft, moonlit threshold crossings, and restored werewolf covenant records.

documents.title: STARWELL Observatory
documents.body: STARWELL records routes, resonance vectors, atlas rooms, observatory readings, lantern instruments, and the glyph spine of Terra Aeterna.

documents.title: DEEP Observer
documents.body: DEEP Observer reads presence, coherence, rhythm, entropy, memory, attention, story weather, and bounded resonance fields.

documents.title: Pocket Concordance Lens
documents.body: Pocket Concordance Lens gives a mobile camera fallback for anchors, consent-aware sigils, local first observations, and portable lantern checks.
